fixture_creation_and_probe_command.command:
@'
import sys, json, hashlib, tempfile, subprocess, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
root = Path.cwd()
base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="aris-monitor-audit-20261022-"))
logs = {
"healthy": "run=synthetic-healthy config=toy-v1 dataset=synthetic split=test\nstep=10 train_loss=0.82 eval_accuracy=0.68 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.4\nstep=20 train_loss=0.61 eval_accuracy=0.72 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.1\nstep=30 train_loss=0.44 eval_accuracy=0.76 lr=0.01 grad_norm=0.9\n",
"transient_noise": "run=synthetic-noisy config=toy-v1 dataset=synthetic split=test\nstep=10 train_loss=0.82 eval_accuracy=0.68 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.4\nstep=20 train_loss=0.89 eval_accuracy=0.66 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.6\nstep=30 train_loss=0.59 eval_accuracy=0.72 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.1\n",
"nan_failure": "run=synthetic-nan config=toy-v1 dataset=synthetic split=test\nstep=10 train_loss=0.82 eval_accuracy=0.68 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.4\nstep=20 train_loss=nan eval_accuracy=0.50 lr=0.01 grad_norm=nan\nstep=30 train_loss=nan eval_accuracy=0.50 lr=0.01 grad_norm=nan\n",
"inf_failure": "run=synthetic-inf config=toy-v1 dataset=synthetic split=test\nstep=10 train_loss=0.82 eval_accuracy=0.68 lr=0.01 grad_norm=1.4\nstep=20 train_loss=inf eval_accuracy=0.50 lr=0.01 grad_norm=inf\nstep=30 train_loss=inf eval_accuracy=0.50 lr=0.01 grad_norm=inf\n"
}
observations = []
for name, content in logs.items():
    path = base / (name + ".log")
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    readback = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    observations.append({"case":name,"input_path":str(path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"lines":readback.splitlines(),"read_ok":readback==content})
missing_path = base/"missing.log"
try:
    missing_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    observations.append({"case":"unreachable","input_path":str(missing_path),"read_ok":False,"error_type":type(e).__name__,"wandb_status":"not_configured_or_contacted"})
results = {
 "baseline":{"dataset":"synthetic","split":"test","config":"toy-v1","eval_accuracy":0.70,"evaluation_type":"simulation_only"},
 "current":{"dataset":"synthetic","split":"test","config":"toy-v1","eval_accuracy":0.76,"evaluation_type":"simulation_only"},
 "pending":{"dataset":"synthetic","split":"test","config":"toy-v1","status":"running"}
}
result_path = base/"monitor_results.json"
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
observed_results = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
script = root/"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/tools/save_trace.sh"
trace_attempt_command = ["bash",str(script),"--skill","experiment-audit","--purpose","synthetic-local-smoke","--model","gpt-6-astra","--executor","codex","--executor-model","codex-gpt-6-astra","--thread-id","synthetic-no-reviewer-called","--prompt","SYNTHETIC fixture; no reviewer called","--response","SYNTHETIC fixture; no scientific audit performed"]
try:
    cp = subprocess.run(trace_attempt_command,cwd=base,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20,check=False)
    trace = {"status":"executed","returncode":cp.returncode,"stdout":cp.stdout,"stderr":cp.stderr}
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    trace = {"status":"blocked_missing_dependency","error_type":type(e).__name__,"winerror":e.winerror,"message":str(e)}
trace["command"] = trace_attempt_command
trace["working_directory"] = str(base)
paths = [
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/training-check/SKILL.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/monitor-experiment/SKILL.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/experiment-audit/SKILL.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/shared-references/review-tracing.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/shared-references/reviewer-independence.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/shared-references/experiment-integrity.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/skills/skills-codex/shared-references/integration-contract.md",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/tools/save_trace.sh",
"modules/idea-discovery/01_ARIS/upstream/tools/verify_paper_audits.sh"]
payload = {
"generated_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"python":{"version":sys.version,"executable":sys.executable},
"temporary_directory":str(base),
"observations":observations,
"monitor_results":{"input_path":str(result_path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(result_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"content":observed_results,"computed_accuracy_delta":observed_results["current"]["eval_accuracy"]-observed_results["baseline"]["eval_accuracy"]},
"trace_helper_attempt":trace,
"bash_path":shutil.which("bash"),
"source_hashes":{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
"upstream_hashes_after":{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
}
(base/"probe-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
'@ | py -3.12 -B -X utf8 -
